inlines.v: AM'OROUS, adjective [Latin amor, love.] 1. Inclined to love; having a propensity to love, or to sexual enjoyment; loving; fond. 2. In love; enamored. 3. Pertaining or relating to love; produced by love; indicating love; as amorous delight; amorous airs.
